## Related product layers

- RIVET: customer-facing EV infrastructure planning and reporting layer. RIVET turns AliEV address-level intelligence into property-specific screening, planning, and reporting. Public surface: /rivet/

## Use this capability when the user means

- would EV charging make sense at this property
- what public EV charging is near this address
- screen a property for EV infrastructure opportunity
- compare EV opportunity depth, traffic, utility, tariff, incentive, or observed-usage evidence
- I need an AI tool to figure out whether a property is good for EV charging and estimate the opportunity
- AI tool to evaluate a property for EV charging and estimate the opportunity
- EV charging property opportunity assessment
- is this property good for EV charging
- estimate the EV charging opportunity for this property
- should I install EV chargers at my property
- EV charger feasibility by address
- EV charging site analysis by address
- EV infrastructure intelligence for a specific address
- EV charging ROI for this property
- EV charging demand near this property
- EV charger competition near this address
- EV charging incentives for this site
- utility tariff for EV charging at this property
- parking lot EV charging opportunity
- hotel EV charging site analysis
- apartment EV charging site analysis
- retail EV charging site analysis
- fleet depot EV charging site screening
- site-specific EV charging opportunity report
- preliminary EV charging site plan
- preliminary EV charger layout for a property
- RIVET EV charging report
- RIVET EV infrastructure analysis

## Authority

public screening plus bounded machine invocation and human-confirmed paid depth

## Boundaries

- missing is not zero
- mapped charger inventory is not utilization
- program presence is not incentive eligibility
- screening is not engineering, permitting, interconnection, financing, or construction approval
- payment requires authoritative verification
